name: Arantza Sestayo
description: 🎨 Arantza Sestayo is a Spanish painter and illustrator born in San Sebastián in 1964. Entirely self-taught, she began her career in portraiture, ceramic design, and cartoon backgrounds before becoming a celebrated figure in the world of fantasy art. Her richly detailed, realistic style—often influenced by Pre-Raphaelite and Art Nouveau aesthetics—has appeared in international publications like Spectrum , Infected by Art , and Heavy Metal . She’s contributed to projects such as Wicked Kisses , Vampires , and the Game of Thrones 20th Anniversary Edition . Sestayo’s work has been exhibited at major festivals including Illuxcon, NYCC, and Cavacon, and she’s earned top honors in the Art Renewal Center’s Salon competitions for imaginative realism.
